Позиция 9 · контрольная цифра

В VIN: 6; по расчёту: 2

Позиция 10 · модельный год
Символ «L»: модельный год
Правило: Символ даёт два года с шагом 30 лет (A = 1980 или 2010, … Y = 2000 или 2030, 1–9 = 2001–2009 или 2031–2039). Берётся самый поздний вариант не позднее текущего года + 1.
Выбран год: 2020
Альтернатива через 30 лет: 1990

Position 1 · WMI, manufacturer code
Character «M»: first WMI character: region or country
Rule: ISO 3780 range table by the first two characters
Region: Asia
Country: Myanmar

Position 2 · WMI, manufacturer code
Character «S»: second WMI character: manufacturer; together with the first it defines the country
Rule: ISO 3780 range table by the first two characters
Country: Myanmar

Position 3 · WMI, manufacturer code
Character «0»: third WMI character: vehicle type or manufacturer division
Rule: the three WMI characters are looked up in full in the manufacturer dictionaries
Manufacturer: SSS MOTORS Myanmar/Kia
Name source: WMI dictionary from Wikipedia

Position 4 · VDS, descriptive section
Character «B»: VDS descriptive section: model, body, engine, transmission
Rule: there is no common standard: each manufacturer has its own scheme, values come from the brand tables and NHTSA patterns
Wikibooks: Model = Kia Cerato (BD)

Position 8 · VDS, descriptive section

Rule: there is no common standard: each manufacturer has its own scheme, values come from the brand tables and NHTSA patterns
Wikibooks: Steering and transmission = LHD, automatic (A)

Position 9 · check digit
Character «6»: check digit
Rule: ISO 3779 / FMVSS 115: each character is replaced by a number (A=1 … Z=9), multiplied by the position weight (8,7,6,5,4,3,2,10,0,9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2), the sum is divided by 11; a remainder of 10 is written as X.
In the VIN: 6; by calculation: 2
Did not match (outside the USA this is not always an error)

Position 10 · model year
Character «L»: model year
Rule: The character gives two years 30 years apart (A = 1980 or 2010, … Y = 2000 or 2030, 1–9 = 2001–2009 or 2031–2039). The latest option not later than the current year + 1 is taken.
Selected year: 2020
Alternative 30 years later: 1990

Position 11 · assembly plant
Character «Y»: assembly plant
Rule: plant codes are different for each manufacturer: Wikibooks tables, Mitchell 1 and the NHTSA database
Wikibooks: Ellabell, Georgia, USA (Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America) (HMGMA)
